scope: Supplementary follow-up to per-city source notes; no values imported from contradictory or insufficient evidence.

findings.outcome: YatraDham page gives 07:00-19:30 and FAQ 06:00-20:00. Other secondary hours differ. Official tourism page does not settle it. Remains unknown.

Official park opening uses daylight; fixed annual clock interval unsupported. ASI/UNESCO searches confirm protection but no current Kevada standalone price. Historical funded accessibility works or proposed works do not establish current access. Secondary free/shared/separate fees conflict.

Official 2023 directory gives foreign/student tariffs and historical hours only. Current business listing reports temporary closure. Secondary general Indian tariffs2/5/10 conflict. No current reopening date or physical access verified.

AMC budget documents wheelchair availability at Kankaria entrances, not all attractions/rides. Sarkhej tour access is tour-specific. Sabarmati website accessibility statement is digital WCAG, not physical. Calico commercial discounted-ticket claim conflicts with official free prebooking, so its generic accessibility checkbox was rejected. No whole-site booleans inferred.
Trust confirms temple mobility facilities only; no transfer of temple boolean to Bhalka, Triveni ghats or beach. Stepped ghats and beach access remain unverified as a whole.
Forest booking terms confirm vehicles/slots but no verified wheelchair loading, securement or vehicle dimensions. General hotel accessibility does not establish safari access.
Partial hardstanding/assisted transfer guidance and Kalo uphill approach documented in city notes. Does not support a universal yes/no for salt surface or viewpoint.
Official page image labels conflict with assets: donhill.jpeg and GirmalWaterfalls.jpg labelled Saputara Lake. Rejected instead of importing a potentially wrong location image.
